sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's digital economy expansion is durable, driven by rising internet penetration and a young, mobile-first population that sustains e-commerce and fintech growth.
Local tech listings (BELI, IRSX, BUKA) are outperforming due to domestic liquidity and policy support, decoupling from US tech volatility.
Hardware and semiconductor supply chains (2454, WGSH) benefit from regional AI and data-center buildouts, creating a structural demand tailwind independent of US rate cycles.

Regulatory tailwinds for sharia-compliant and micro-lending products are creating durable niches, lifting BGTG, BBLD, and TRJA as domestic liquidity rotates into specialized lenders.
sectors.ai: Buy selective exposure to Indonesian financials, led by BSIM and LIFE, as domestic catalysts (rate cuts, loan growth) outweigh US weakness. Favor small-cap insurers and multi-finance names with strong momentum; trim US-sensitive banks. Position for continued ID outperformance over 1-2 months, targeting +5-8% upside on leaders.

sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's coal export demand remains structurally supported by Asian industrial growth and tight seaborne supply, benefiting low-cost producers like BUMI and CUAN.
Domestic energy transition policies, including biomass co-firing and nickel downstreaming, create durable demand for specialty chemicals and mining services, lifting names like INCI and SAMF.
Regulatory clarity on coal domestic market obligations and export quotas continues to drive margin stability for large miners, while small-cap volatility persists due to speculative retail flows.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in coal exporters (BUMI, CUAN) and specialty chemicals (INCI) on strong volume, as Indonesia's energy demand and export pricing hold firm. Trim gains in speculative movers (SQMI, ALKA) lacking earnings support. Maintain WATCH for policy shifts on coal DMO and renewable mandates.

Focus on domestic staples with strong distribution and pricing power; expect continued rotation into small/mid-cap winners. Maintain normal risk, add on dips.

sectors.name: Healthcare
themes: Indonesia's universal health coverage (JKN) expansion continues to drive volume growth for hospital chains and pharmaceutical distributors, insulating them from global macro swings.
Domestic healthcare names benefit from a young, growing middle class with rising out-of-pocket spending on private care, a durable tailwind absent in mature US markets.
Regulatory support for local vaccine and generic drug manufacturing (e.g., NOVN, DKHH) is accelerating import substitution, creating structural margin expansion opportunities.
sectors.ai: Buy dips in Indonesian hospital operators (HEAL, SAME) and pharma distributors (DKHH) as domestic healthcare demand outpaces US peers; AIMS' +25% spike is speculative—take profits. Rotate into NOVN for vaccine upside. Maintain neutral US exposure; MRNA/CVS rallies are sentiment-driven, not structural.
